name: Rösrath (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided green over white, charged at the centre with the city arms of Rösrath (a red lion on white above a hunting horn on green).
history: Municipal flag of Rösrath; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Rösrath arms — lion and hunting horn
